text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sensing Air Groove's popularity at the 
venue, Mejiro Dober realizes just how far 
she is from reaching "new glory," firing 
herself up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"I'll get closer to the 'ideal' that is 
Air Groove!" Saying this, Mejiro Dober 
couldn't hide her deep admiration for Air 
Groove.
